# Conformance

<!-- Generated by `pnpm conformance:render` from conformance/olah-inventory.json; do not edit. -->

olah is not certified by 1EdTech. It implements the QTI 3.0 specifications and the companion specifications they
reference; this matrix states, for every construct, how it is evidenced. Evidence uses public material only.

## Evidence

| Code | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| R | Round trip: models satisfy read(write(m)) = m; documents of the corpus survive read and write unchanged up to canonical form |
| X | Written output validates against the official XSD |
| S | Unit test whose expected value is a statement or worked example of the cited section |
| P | Property of the semantics, checked by fast-check |
| D | Differential test against Longsight qti3-core on items |
| C | Corpus document read, validated and, where it has processing, executed |
| N | Negative fixture that must produce the named issue or error |
| V | Exhaustive vocabulary test: every term accepted, any other term rejected |
| U | Unit test of data access only, where the specification has no semantics |

A test names its rows in brackets, such as `[A79]`. A row needs a test once its unit is merged.

The choice is stored and emitted as `variant-selected`; results keep the item ref identifier (RR §2.4.5). ## Out of scope

Constructs that olah leaves to the system that owns them.

| Row | Construct | Source | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C12 | Access token scopes, OAuth, HTTPS | CAT §5 | the port adapter (tempuh, server side) |
| C13 | QTI 2.x `adaptiveItemSelection` inside `selection` | CAT §2.1 | QTI 2.x content (N13) |
| J10 | PCI JavaScript API, AMD loading, timeouts, fallback switching | BPIG §3.7.12 | PCI host (N4) |
| N1 | Rendering HTML5, MathML (MathJax), SSML and CSS; DOM; shared-vocabulary classes; layout; interaction widgets |  | Item renderer: tempuh (browser) |
| N2 | Delivery UI: navigation controls, review and solution screens, timers on screen, companion tools (calculator, rule, protractor) |  | tempuh (browser) |
| N3 | Wall clocks and timer scheduling |  | tempuh (server for exams, browser for practice) |
| N4 | Hosting PCIs: AMD loading, sandboxing, the PCI JavaScript API |  | PCI host: tempuh (browser) |
| N5 | CAT algorithms, HTTP transport and OAuth to CAT engines (CAT §3, §5) |  | CAT adapter: tempuh (server), backed by an IRT library or a CAT REST service |
| N6 | IRT and other psychometrics |  | Psychometrics library (takar) |
| N7 | LTI 1.3 and Advantage launch, deep linking and grade passback (LTI 1.1 is not supported) |  | tempuh (server) |
| N8 | Storage of packages, sessions, results and uploaded files |  | Host application |
| N9 | Human scoring UI and machine (LLM or other) scoring services |  | tempuh (server) workflow and external scoring services |
| N10 | Authoring UX |  | Authoring tool |
| N11 | Deciding which candidate gets which accommodation; rostering; proctoring |  | Test administration system |
| N12 | Fetching anything over a network at run time (remote templates, schemas, modules, XInclude targets) |  | Host application, tempuh |
| N13 | QTI 1.x/2.x import and APIP migration (MIGR) |  | Deferred future subpath `migrate`; until then a migration tool |
| N14 | Analytics events (Caliper) |  | tempuh (server) |
| N15 | 1EdTech certification and member-only test sets (CERT §4.4) |  | Vendor of a certified product; revisited after 1.0 |
